scope: Day 6 durable queued parsing, explicit reconciliation, deadlines, process cleanup and dependency readiness
verification_distinctions: Real Redis, PostgreSQL, spawned RQ workers and loopback HTTP were exercised.
Delivery acknowledgement loss, clock advancement and selected database/service exceptions were explicit fault injections.
Real worker SIGKILL, parser SIGSTOP, process cleanup, timeout and heartbeat freshness were exercised.
Fast checks intentionally skip database/container/queue checks; skips are not counted as passes.
No model calls, real-model evaluation, retrieval quality benchmark or medical answer evaluation.
warnings: Existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning for httpx; no extra HTTP dependency added.

review.correctness: Conditional transitions, atomic stage/chunks, stale execution fences.
review.error_handling: Durable delivery intent, safe errors, deadline reconciliation and disabled-owner handling.
review.tests: Success, edge, failure, concurrency, migration, real cross-process and outage recovery executed.
review.security: JSON and fixed function allowlist, owner checks, sanitized argv/logs and isolated test targets.
review.maintainability: Existing parser/storage reused, two direct dependencies added, RQ spawn adaptation requires upgrade regression.

remaining_limits: Reconciliation is explicit, not a periodic scheduler; failed stages have no manual retry endpoint.
Complete ingest and embeddings are pending; PARSED is not READY and the parent job remains PENDING.
Complete-ingest attempts/cumulative budgets are not implemented by the preprocessing stage.
Pending parent jobs continue to count toward the five-task quota; historical app rows are retained.
macOS parser hard address-space limit remains unavailable; process cleanup is not a hostile-file sandbox.
Readiness has a 10-second heartbeat freshness window and checks DB/upload-root scope, not every deployment setting or file.
No multi-host clock/network-partition guarantee, backup restore drill, global quotas or public deployment acceptance.

delivery.git_delivery_note: Verification snapshot predates Git delivery; consult Git history for subsequent commits and pushes.

issues_found_and_resolved: Accepted empty username in standard authenticated Redis URL; validated by config regression.
Aligned transport assertions with JSON arrays deserializing as lists.
Closed owned DB pool on queue configuration startup failure.
Preserved tightened parse limits in execution environment whitelist.
Recorded safe terminal failure when owner is disabled before or during execution.
Protected runtime environment repr and sanitized historical failure-log context.
Used verified existing interpreter path after offline version-discovery failure.
